description: App-command grants for `chat-*` windows: 1:1 friend chat, with start and hang-up of a call to this peer and the peer's safety number with its mark-verified flow (the header's badge), and the group mode (plan E2.6): the group list, a group's stored messages, its send and typing, and Leave, and opening a link preview's page (`open_external_url`, which asks in Rust before it opens). A friend's game invite: its game name and joining it (`launch_game_to_server`), and inviting the friend (`send_game_invite`). No plugin grants.
